stories.title: Lula diz que plano de ajuste de Flávio Bolsonaro é para 'cortar do sangue do povo'

en.title: Lula says that Flávio Bolsonaro's adjustment plan is to 'cut from the blood of the people'
en.summary: President Lula criticized his runoff opponent Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's fiscal adjustment proposal, characterizing it as harmful to ordinary citizens.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro afirma que dará reajuste acima da inflação para aposentadorias se eleito

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro states that he will grant pension increases above inflation if elected
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to provide pension adjustments exceeding the inflation rate should he win the election.

stories.title: TSE adia julgamento sobre candidatura de Deltan Dallagnol, eleito senador no domingo (4)

en.title: TSE postpones judgment on candidacy of Deltan Dallagnol, elected senator on Sunday (4)
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court delayed its decision on whether former Lava Jato prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol's Senate candidacy was valid after he received 2.9 million votes in Paraná.

stories.title: TSE adia julgamento que definirá validade da eleição de Dallagnol ao Senado pelo PR

en.title: TSE postpones judgment that will define validity of Dallagnol's election to Senate for Paraná
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court delayed its ruling on whether Deltan Dallagnol's Senate election in Paraná will be validated.

stories.title: Site oferece criptomoeda a quem divulgar conteúdo que defende voto em Flávio Bolsonaro; lei eleitoral proíbe remuneração por propaganda

en.title: Website offers cryptocurrency to those who share content supporting votes for Flávio Bolsonaro; electoral law prohibits payment for campaign promotion
en.summary: A cryptocurrency website is offering digital tokens to users who promote a community supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy on social media, while also claiming to support a children's project in Uganda. Brazilian electoral law prohibits monetary compensation for campaign advertising.

stories.title: Justiça dos EUA acrescenta tortura às acusações contra Nicolás Maduro

en.title: US Justice adds torture charges against Nicolás Maduro
en.summary: The United States has added torture allegations to the criminal accusations filed against Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro.

stories.title: TSE adia julgamento sobre registro de candidatura de Deltan Dallagnol

en.title: TSE postpones ruling on Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy registration
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court postponed its judgment on whether Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy registration remains valid. A new date for the ruling will be scheduled.

stories.title: Publicamente, Flávio Bolsonaro defende reajuste de aposentadorias acima da inflação

en.title: Publicly, Flávio Bolsonaro defends pension increases above inflation
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro stated he would raise social security pensions above inflation rates if elected. He also expressed opposition to a payment-splitting mechanism introduced by recent tax reform.

stories.title: Quem era o juiz encontrado carbonizado dentro de carro no interior de SP

en.title: Who was the judge found charred inside a car in the interior of SP
en.summary: A judge was discovered dead and charred inside a vehicle in rural São Paulo state.

stories.title: Juiz é encontrado carbonizado dentro de carro em São João da Boa Vista (SP)

en.title: Judge found charred inside car in São João da Boa Vista (SP)
en.summary: Judge Gustavo de Castro Campos, 45, was discovered charred inside his vehicle on a rural road in São João da Boa Vista on Wednesday evening.

stories.title: Juiz é encontrado morto dentro de veículo em chamas no interior de SP

en.title: Judge found dead inside burning vehicle in the interior of SP
en.summary: Judge Gustavo de Castro Campos from São Paulo's Court of Justice was discovered charred in a burning car in rural São João da Boa Vista. Military and fire officials responded and investigators registered it as a suspicious death.

stories.title: Juiz do Tribunal de Justiça de SP é encontrado carbonizado dentro de carro no interior paulista

en.title: Judge from São Paulo Court of Justice found charred inside car in interior region
en.summary: A judge from São Paulo's Court of Justice was discovered dead and charred inside a vehicle in rural São Paulo.

stories.title: Exclusivo: Oncoclínicas já tem adesão de cerca de 70% dos credores para recuperação extrajudicial

en.title: Exclusive: Oncoclínicas already has adhesion from around 70% of creditors for out-of-court recovery
en.summary: Oncoclínicas has obtained approval from approximately 70% of its creditors for its out-of-court recovery plan. The plan provides for extended payment terms and reduced debt forgiveness on a R$ 5.1 billion debt.

stories.title: O que se sabe sobre a morte de funcionária de instituto de peste na Rússia?

en.title: What is known about the death of an employee at a plague institute in Russia?
en.summary: A laboratory employee at a plague research institute in Siberia died in unclear circumstances in October, prompting authorities to quarantine around 200 people. Officials have not linked the death to her work or the plague.

stories.title: Presidente do BoE teme que governos fiquem sem espaço fiscal para reagir a novas crises

en.title: BoE president fears governments will lack fiscal space to respond to new crises
en.summary: The Bank of England's president warned that governments' ability to respond to economic downturns is constrained by weak growth and recent shocks. He emphasized the need for reliable fiscal policies amid pressures on government bond markets.

stories.title: Investimentos globais em publicidade devem crescer 11,9% em 2026 e atingir US$ 1,34 trilhão

en.title: Global advertising investments are expected to grow 11.9% in 2026 and reach US$ 1.34 trillion
en.summary: Global advertising investments are projected to reach US$ 1.34 trillion in 2026, growing 11.9%, despite cautious consumers and economic and geopolitical uncertainties. The forecast was released by Warc Media, a marketing research firm.

stories.title: Pix ultrapassa marca de 1 bilhão de chaves cadastradas

en.title: Pix surpasses 1 billion registered keys
en.summary: Brazil's instant payment system Pix exceeded 1 billion registered keys in September, with random keys comprising over half of all registrations. Users can register various identifier types including phone numbers, tax IDs, or email addresses to facilitate transfers.
